name: Lethean-Carn
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by massive canyon systems near the terminator.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
Established during the last boom, the automated beacon of unknown purpose was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Whoever controls platinum controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
